deep level of technical involvement: At Thryv I built an AI code reviewer that audits every open pull request across our services for security, correctness, performance, and team standards, then ranks the findings by confidence and stages the strongest as human-approved comments. The genuinely hard part was security judgment at scale, reliably separating a real vulnerability from a false positive so engineers actually act on it. Around the same time I led our Auth0 and SAML 2.0 identity integration across every Thryv application and drove OWASP Top 10 and CASA compliance for our Command Center. Building software that makes security continuous is the work I love, and it maps directly to the 60/40 split in this role.

Platform Security there isn't a checkbox, it's core to the product, and that is exactly the kind of work I want to be doing. I have spent years making security continuous: Auth0 and SAML identity across an org, OWASP Top 10 compliance, and an AI reviewer that catches issues before they ship. I am PenTest+ and CEH certified because I genuinely enjoy thinking like an attacker and then engineering the defense.
